items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jazz people, OWENS - Yeah, well, I didn't have no special people, I used to go listen to Jimmy Harrison.

ctx.x: Well, who were some of your favorites that you listened to in that period?

Jazz people, OWENS - Yeah, well, I didn't have no special people, I used to go listen to Jimmy Harrison. I said I was as good as they were. (... playing the horn ...) because practically every night, you know, that's when these places would stay open all night and we'd get through playing -- we'd play until 4 o'clock in the morning. Sometimes you'd play up until the next day ... sit back and drink your bottle, get high and blow your horn.
What were you playing? I mean, what kind of songs? Do you remember some of the songs?
